 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. At just 19, Yan Diomande was hardly a household name before the 2026 World Cup . So when Real Madrid paid RB Leipzig €125 million for the Ivorian, the transfer raised plenty of eyebrows. However, the gamble is increasingly looking like a smart one, with the youngster already showing signs that he could soon challenge one of the club's biggest stars. 
 With Vinícius Júnior suspended, Diomande has stepped up in José Mourinho 's side. And he has done much more than simply fill a gap. The winger has been producing impressive performances, offering individual quality while also bringing a balance to the team that has arguably been missing since Kylian Mbappé 's arrival.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Diomande was on target again at the weekend, scoring a fine goal in Real Madrid's 3-0 away win over Racing Santander. He also won over the home supporters with a gesture off the pitch, handing his shirt to a young ball boy when he was substituted.
 The reaction from the stands said it all, with the home fans applauding the teenager for his gesture.
 In truth, Diomande had already been making a strong case for a regular starting place before Vinícius was sent off against Villarreal on 10 October. The Ivorian started that game and scored the winning goal, marking his first strike in a Real Madrid shirt.
 Since then, he has featured in another five matches, starting four of them. During that run, he has added three goals and three assists, averaging more than one goal contribution per game.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Despite beginning the season as a substitute, Diomande has already registered more goals and assists than Vinícius. He has also played more minutes than the Brazilian, despite making fewer starts - seven compared with nine.
 His impact has not been limited to his attacking numbers, either. Diomande ranks third in La Liga for successful dribbles, behind only Lamine Yamal and Mbappé , but has the best minutes-per-dribble ratio in the competition. His willingness to contribute defensively has also caught the eye.
 "When more attacking players do the hard graft, they send a positive message to the group," Mourinho said when discussing the defensive work of Diomande and Jude Bellingham .
 Vinícius, meanwhile, has endured a difficult spell, scoring just once this season. When he returns from suspension, he may find that his place in the starting XI is no longer guaranteed, with Diomande emerging as an unexpected rival.
